usage: deskops message read [-h] [--root ROOT] [--desk-root DESK_ROOT]
                            [--store STORE] [--repo REPO]
                            [--pythonpath PYTHONPATH]
                            [--format {text,json,yaml}]
                            selector

positional arguments:
  selector              Message filename, stem, or unique slug fragment

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Repository root whose desk/ holds the inbox
  --desk-root DESK_ROOT
                        Desk root directory override; defaults to the active
                        project desk
  --store STORE         Store path used to resolve the target project root for
                        the default desk
  --repo REPO           Target a registered repository name in the ecosystem
  --pythonpath PYTHONPATH
                        Project path used when auto-tracking messages through
                        the registered model
  --format {text,json,yaml}
